tokens.iast: athābhiṣekasya vidhiḥ kathyate pārameśvaraḥ yaiṣā putrakadīkṣoktā gurusādhakayorapi / saivādhikāriṇī bhogyatattvayuktimatī kramāt svabhyastajñāninaṃ santaṃ bubhūṣumatha bhāvinam / yogyaṃ jñātvā svādhikāraṃ gurustasmai samarpayet yo naivaṃ veda naivāsāvabhiṣikto@pi daiśikaḥ / samayyādikrameṇeti śrīmatkāmika ucyate yo na vedādhvasandhānaṃ ṣoḍhā bāhyāntarasthitam / sa gururmocayenneti siddhayogīśvarīmate sarvalakṣaṇahīno@pi jñānavān gururiṣyate / jñānaprādhānyamevoktamiti śrīkacabhārgave padavākyapramāṇajñaḥ śivabhaktyekatatparaḥ / samastaśivaśāstrārthaboddhā kāruṇiko guruḥ na svayaṃbhūstasya coktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ parameśinā / abhakto jīvitadhiyā kurvannīśānadhiṣṭhitaḥ paścātmanā svayaṃbhūṣṇurnādhikārī sa kutracit / bhasmāṅkuro vratisuto duḥśīlātanayastathā kuṇḍo golaśca te duṣṭā uktaṃ devyākhyayāmale / punarbhūścānyaliṅgo yaḥ punaḥ śaive pratiṣṭhitaḥ

tokens.iast: śrīpūrvaśāstre na tveṣa niyamaḥ ko@pi coditaḥ / yathārthatattvasaṃghajñastathā śiṣye prakāśakaḥ yaḥ punaḥ sarvatattvāni vettītyādi ca lakṣaṇam / yogacāre ca yadyatra tantre coditamācaret tathaiva siddhaye seyamājñeti kila varṇitam / yastu karmitayācāryastatra kāṇādivarjanam yataḥ kārakasāmagryātkarmaṇo nādhikaḥ kvacit / devyā yāmalaśāstre ca kāñcyādiparivarjanam taddṛṣṭadoṣātkrodhādeḥ samyakjñātaryasau kutaḥ / guravastu svayaṃbhvādi varjyaṃ yadyāmalādiṣu karmyabhiprāyataḥ sarvaṃ taditi vyācacakṣire / ato deśakulācāradehalakṣaṇakalpanām anādṛtyaiva saṃpūrṇajñānaṃ kuryādgururgurum / prāgvatsaṃpūjya hutvā ca śrāvayitvā cikīrṣitam tato@bhiṣiñcettaṃ śiṣyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā tataḥ sakṛt / tanmantrarasatoyena pūrvoktavidhinā guruḥ vibhavena suvistīrṇaṃ tatastasmai vadetsvakam / sarvaṃ kartavyasāraṃ yacchāstrāṇāṃ paramaṃ rahaḥ anugrāhyāstvayā śiṣyāḥ śivaśaktipracoditāḥ / uktaṃ jñānottare caitadbrāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ

tokens.iast: napuṃsakāḥ striyaḥ śūdrā ye cānye@pi tadarthinaḥ / te dīkṣāyāṃ na mīmāṃsyā jñānakāle vicārayet jñānamūlo guruḥ proktaḥ saptasatrīṃ pravartayet / dīkṣā vyākhyā kṛpā maitrī śāstracintā śivaikatā annādidānamityetatpālayetsaptasatrakam / abhiṣekavidhau cāsmai karaṇīkhaṭikādikam sarvopakaraṇavrātamarpaṇīyaṃ vipaścite / so@bhiṣikto guruṃ paścāddakṣiṇābhiḥ prapūjayet jñānahīno guruḥ karmī svādhikāraṃ samarpya no / dīkṣādyadhikṛtiṃ kuryādvinā tasyājñayā punaḥ ityevaṃ śrāvayetso@pi namaskṛtyābhinandayet / tataḥ prabhṛtyasau pūrvo gurustyaktādhikārakaḥ yathecchaṃ vicaredvyākhyādīkṣādau yantraṇojjhitaḥ / kurvanna bādhyate yasmāddīpāddīpavadīdṛśaḥ santāno nādhikārasya cyavo@kurvanna bādhyate / prāk ca kurvanvihanyeta siddhātantre taducyate yathārthamupadeśaṃ tu kurvannācārya ucyate / na cāvajñā kriyākāle saṃsāroddharaṇaṃ prati na dīkṣeta guruḥ śiṣyaṃ tattvayuktastu garvataḥ / yo@sya syānnarake vāsa iha ca vyādhito bhavet
